thumbnail_brief: One giant army ant soldier head (dark red-brown, sickle jaws, no face, never cute) filling half the frame, with tiny red-capped Doug asleep in a low hammock below and the dark swarm carpet pouring in from the edge, so the picture shows the one victim who isn't moving while the title explains why that kills him; text at most 3 words such as 'DON'T SLEEP', never ANT, KILL, RUN, DOUG, VS or any ant count like 1000.
description:
Army ants are nearly blind, yet one Eciton burchellii colony can catch about 3,000 animals an hour, and the whole rainforest floor runs from the raid. A grown person can simply walk away. In this army ant deep dive Doug does not: he walks from the swarm front back along the trail to the queen in the living nest, then lies in the path of twenty million African driver ants.

Where should we send Doug next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad decision.
